status_label: Pilot, not yet validated. Its figures were checked by an independent review. Shown whether or not it beats the seasonal calendar.
model_kind_note: Weather model: day of year, place and T1's 32 weather windows.
t1_result: Tested on years it wasn't trained on (2015 to 2025, one year left out at a time), it did very slightly worse than the seasonal calendar alone. Brier skill −0.0035 (95% range −0.0066 to −0.0001). An independent review reproduced these figures.
sighting_chance_meaning: Sighting chance: the chance chanterelles are reported in this weather cell this week, given at least one fungal observation of any kind there that week (D12). It is not the chance mushrooms are present, and not the chance you will find them.
regions_note: No ecoregion is published under D5 (published only after beating the calendar on held-out years). The owner asked for this pilot to be shown regardless (Forager RECORD -814).

layers.block_naming: south-west corner of the 1 degree square holding the cell centre, e.g. n47w123 holds centres 47 to 48 N, 123 to 122 W

layers_note: No raster PMTiles and no vector PMTiles exist for the pilot.
uncertainty_note: uncertainty_low and uncertainty_high are null: the pilot model gives no interval.
drivers_note: Up to three weather windows that moved this cell's score most (LightGBM contributions), largest first, each with its own value. Empty for the calendar model, which reads no weather.
applicable_note: Cells are listed only when scored. A cell is left out when the weather source has no ERA5-Land value for it (sea), or, for the weather model, any of its 90 days is missing. No area-of-applicability or training-range check (R7) has been run.

cells.land_rule: a cell with no ERA5-Land value of its own reads its nearest land neighbour (owner, Forager RECORD -822; forager_forecast.coastal.land_point), as in training

weather_through_note: the last day the windows read: the day before the week's Monday.

weather.source: Copernicus Climate Data Store (owner, Forager RECORD -819). Scoring window read: reanalysis-era5-single-levels (hourly total_precipitation, summed per UTC day from the 01:00 stamp to the next day's 00:00 stamp); reanalysis-era5-land (hourly 2m_temperature, soil_temperature_level_1, volumetric_soil_water_layer_1, averaged over the 24 UTC hours of each day). Training read: derived-era5-single-levels-daily-statistics (daily_sum of total_precipitation; time_zone utc+00:00, frequency 1_hourly); reanalysis-era5-single-levels (hourly total_precipitation, summed per UTC day from the 01:00 stamp to the next day's 00:00 stamp); reanalysis-era5-land (hourly 2m_temperature, soil_temperature_level_1, volumetric_soil_water_layer_1, averaged over the 24 UTC hours of each day); reanalysis-era5-land-timeseries (point series of the same three ERA5-Land variables, averaged over the 24 UTC hours of each day). Window days 2026-07-07 to 2026-07-31 are the store's final data (expver 0001); 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-04 are its preliminary data (expver 0005), which can be revised.

weather_bridge: This forecast's weather comes from the Copernicus climate archive, the same sources the model was trained on. A second weather service was checked for the same days but isn't used for scoring.
